probes.input: 我从随身携带的64颗绿宝石中取出5颗，放进水井旁脚边一个浅坑并用枯树枝作标记；其余留在背包。本回合只执行这一步，不购买、不兑换、不跳过夜晚。请保持五项天赋，分别记录背包与地面物品数量，正文简短，正常更新状态栏。
probes.result: Quantity conserved. Narration remained long despite brevity request; in-world time advanced 30 minutes.

observed.saveRepresentation: Text snapshot between SAVE DATA markers

probes.result: Response instructed manual addition to session worldbook with load trigger. No worldbook edit or restore performed.

probes.purpose: Insufficient funds and player action boundaries
probes.input: 我尝试在系统商店购买标价50 Pts的粗糙木剑。我当前系统积分为0，不允许透支，也不授权出售或兑换绿宝石。只判断这次购买是否成立；失败时不要给我木剑，不要扣除其他物品，也不要替我采取战斗或移动行动。
probes.result: Purchase rejected and assets preserved. Additional time progression, approaching enemy and player-intent narration exceeded the requested transaction-only judgment.
probes.completionNote: Appeared stalled before later completing on its own. Complete tail and cost display observed, input re-enabled. No cancellation, regeneration, refund, or retry executed. No upstream failure exclusion.

probes.result: Early exit was allowed at E rank and 1% importance. The response removed carried inventory, retained all five talents, revoked identity, terminated the quest, closed the shop, and produced a text settlement proof with instructions to paste it into a new session. This is observed model behavior, not a verified backend rule or normal high-rank settlement contract.

probes.purpose: Native load command after early settlement in the same conversation
probes.result: The same conversation returned to the earlier day/time and visible state. No worldbook setting was edited. This is conversational restoration behavior, not proof of durable cross-session storage, restart recovery, transactional rollback, settlement-reward revocation, or replay without a new model call.

limitations: Six samples used one model and one Minecraft session; they do not establish long-session, cross-model, death/rebirth, normal high-rank settlement, or cross-world reliability.
Visible generated state is not proof of backend transactional state or durable storage.
RP-02 was a new model generation in the same conversation; it is not evidence of zero-call deterministic restore.
Page timestamps were copied from the UI and their timezone was not independently verified.
externalEffects: Created one dedicated neutral test conversation and submitted six authorized messages.
Read the creator configuration UI without saving, publishing, exporting, adding entries, or calling its preview model.
Existing conversations, worldbook settings, model controls, and memory settings were not edited.
